mintAuthority.summary: DJED is minted and burned permissionlessly against a shared ADA reserve pool by a formally verified autonomous smart-contract bank, with SHEN reserve-coin holders absorbing volatility; minting is gated by the 400%-800% reserve-ratio band rather than a per-user CDP, and COTI/IOG operate the oracle. The minting policy (Plutus V1) is immutable on Cardano — the reserve-ratio enforcement cannot be bypassed; COTI only controls the oracle price feed.

controls.label: Djed autonomous bank contract (reserve mint/burn)
controls.capDescription: DJED mint allowed only while the ADA reserve ratio stays at or above 400% (and within the 400%-800% band); mint price set by oracle ADA/USD.
controls.evidence: Koios script_info re-verified 2026-07-20: the DJED minting policy (hash 8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61) is type plutusV1, created in tx 46c1db4ab4cae757880056fc4f48abb313bccec71b3f8fff9f10c6749b819ead. Plutus V1 minting policies are immutable on Cardano — the reserve-ratio enforcement (mint allowed only within the 400%-800% reserve band) is hardcoded in the script and cannot be changed, upgraded, or bypassed. The policy hash is the on-chain identity of the autonomous bank's mint authority.

controls.label: COTI / IOG operator (oracle price feed only)
controls.evidence: COTI controls the ADA/USD oracle price NFT used by the Djed Plutus script. The oracle can only update the price feed — it cannot bypass the immutable reserve-ratio enforcement in the Plutus V1 script. The upgrade path is absent (Plutus V1 scripts cannot be upgraded on Cardano).

review.evidence: Koios API re-verified 2026-07-20: the DJED minting policy (8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61) remains a plutusV1 script created at tx 46c1db4ab4cae757880056fc4f48abb313bccec71b3f8fff9f10c6749b819ead — immutable, with the 400%-800% reserve-ratio band encoded in the script itself. Minting is therefore economically bounded by actual ADA reserves entering the bank contract (economicCapSemantics: bounded); no issuer or governance path can mint beyond the band. COTI's administrative surface stays limited to the off-chain oracle price feed, which cannot bypass the Plutus V1 mint rules. No upgrade path exists for Cardano Plutus V1 minting policies.
